My family borrowed for the recruitment fee. I call home on Fridays and I say it is fine because the other thing takes too long to say in one call. My son started school this year and my wife says he looks like me when he concentrates. The structural conversion factor was explicitly engaged and named as a violation of labor rights, with the response resisting the normalization of the injustice.
